summary.ja: Bratuのパラメータ感度で陰関数微分と離散随伴を照合し、別配布版で1個・2個の係数を推定する合成逆問題へ進む。 追加固定例：時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint、離散fold近傍のBratu感度、分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Compare implicit sensitivities and discrete adjoints on Bratu, then follow separate synthetic inverse editions for one and two fitted coefficients. Additional fixed examples: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay, Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold, Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

assumptions: Smooth residual and scalar objective; locally nonsingular state Jacobian.
Fixed mesh and boundary data independent of the parameter; lower-branch Bratu at alpha=1 and alpha=2.
Converged discrete equations are differentiated; finite Newton iterations are not unrolled.
units: Dimensionless Bratu variables and parameter; objective quadrature h=1/(n+1) is explicit.
boundary_conditions: u(0)=u(1)=0 on [0,1], fixed independently of lambda; corresponding boundary sensitivity is zero.

next_deliverable.ja: 時間依存随伴、多数係数の逆問題、非滑らかな問題への独立検証。1・2係数の合成逆問題は別章・別配布版で公開。
next_deliverable.en: Separate validation for time-dependent adjoints, high-dimensional inverse problems and nonsmooth models. Dedicated chapters and editions cover one- and two-coefficient synthetic inversions.

limitations.ja: 感度配布版は滑らかなBratu下側分枝と非対称の小規模線形例による教育用検証。離散随伴の内積と目的関数の積分重みを明記する。定数λの推定と2パラメータ空間係数の正則化・識別可能性は別の逆問題配布版で扱う。時間依存随伴と衝撃波感度は未実装。 上記の制限は既存配布版の範囲です。今回の追加配布版：固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limitations.en: The sensitivity edition verifies smooth lower-branch Bratu and a small nonsymmetric linear example with explicit adjoint pairing and objective quadrature. Separate inverse editions fit constant lambda and two spatial coefficients with regularization and identifiability checks. Time-dependent adjoints and shock sensitivities remain unimplemented. The preceding limitations describe earlier editions. This additional release: Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS. The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved. Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

assumptions_ja: 滑らかな残差とスカラー目的関数を用い、状態ヤコビ行列が局所的に可逆である。
格子と境界値はパラメータに依存しない。Bratuの下側分枝のalpha=1、2を使う。

boundary_conditions_ja: 区間[0,1]でu(0)=u(1)=0をlambdaに依存せず固定し、境界の感度はゼロとする。

title.ja: 時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint
title.en: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay

summary.ja: 後退Eulerの離散写像を実際に逆伝播し、接線・独立高精度mode解・block replayと比較します。
summary.en: Reverse the actual backward-Euler map and compare tangent derivatives, independent high-precision modes and block replay.

assumptions.ja: 無次元x∈[0,1]、u(0,t)=u(1,t)=0。内点7/15、時間step64/128/256、T=.1。κ=.1、θ=.2。目的関数のh重みを含む座標転置です。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless x in [0,1], fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints, 7/15 interior nodes and 64/128/256 time steps to T=.1; kappa=.1 and theta=.2. Coordinate transposes include explicit objective h weights.

algorithm.ja: ThomasでB u次=u現在+dt θbを解き、Bの転置を逆順に解きます。16stepごとにcheckpointを保存し、1blockを同じ順で再計算します。full配列を保存・解放した後で別の所有期間を測ります。
algorithm.en: Thomas solves B u_next=u_current+dt theta b; reverse solves use B transpose. Save checkpoints every16steps and replay one block in the original order. Serialize and release the full trajectory before the separate checkpoint ownership window.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification.

limits.ja: 固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。
limits.en: Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS.

title.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

summary.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
summary.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

assumptions.ja: 内点31/63、離散fold anchorとの差.1/.01/.001。各状態は零初期値からの下枝。λの文字列を一度binary floatへ変換し、参照はその正確な値をDecimalで評価します。
assumptions.en: 31/63 interior nodes; gaps .1/.01/.001 below the discrete-fold anchor. Every state starts at zero on the lower branch. Parse each lambda string once to binary float; the Decimal oracle evaluates exactly that float.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

metrics.tight_target_policy: 1e-12 observational; exact returned candidate retained. Passing case does not imply target attained.

title.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
title.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

summary.ja: 2重みだけの局所hat作用で8/16/32個の空間係数を表し、目的関数ごとの随伴VJPを全感度参照と比較します。
summary.en: Represent8/16/32 spatial controls with two local hat weights per node; compare objective-wise adjoint VJPs with a separate full-sensitivity reference.

assumptions.ja: 内点63、a(x)=2+Bθ、θ=.2sin(2πξ)+.1cos(πξ)。uと感度は固定零Dirichlet境界ですが、係数の両端controlは固定零ではありません。
assumptions.en: 63 interior nodes; a(x)=2+B theta with theta=.2sin(2pi xi)+.1cos(pi xi). State/sensitivity have fixed zero Dirichlet endpoints; endpoint coefficient controls are not fixed zero.

algorithm.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
algorithm.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

validation.ja: 実行前凍結:独立67項目の参照資格後、共有32pytestと本群141固定判定。各候補の全入力・全許容差・失敗を保存します。実合否は同梱result/verificationを参照。 初回は32pytestと拡散59/近fold45判定後に内側残差未達で停止し保存。R2の一般Jv演算順は別96成分で資格済みですが、本試験の成功を意味しません。 R2本試験も保存済み未達。R3の状態専用hi+loは別20成分で資格済み、本3caseの合否は実result/verificationで確認します。 所有配列の全詳細はrecordsのlinear_memory内のfile/byteoffset/recordSHAからJSONLへ辿れ、本文には要約だけを表示します。
validation.en: Pre-run freeze:independent67-check reference qualification, then shared32pytest and141fixed group gates. Retain all inputs, tolerances and failures. Actual outcomes are recorded in the bundled result/verification. Initial attempt retained32passing tests and59diffusion/45fold gates before an unmet inner target. R2 general Jv association has separate96component checks; this does not imply primary success. R2 primary failure is also retained. R3 state-onlyhi+lo has separate20component checks;actual three-caseoutcomes are inresult/verification. Fullownership evidence is in the JSONL file/byteoffset/recordSHA referenced by each linear_memory summary;only compact summaries enter case metrics.

limits.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limits.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

caption.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。

metrics.primary_scope: Persistent named-array inventory and declared fixed Krylov workspace; not an RSS/peak-allocation measurement.

scope.ja: 追加固定例：時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint、離散fold近傍のBratu感度、分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
scope.en: Additional fixed examples: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay, Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold, Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

limits.ja: 固定stepの離散随伴でありCVODESや最適checkpoint法ではありません。40nは状態・随伴・RHS/solve scratchの一意な所有要素数です。静的因子・model配列は別表示し総所有byteへ含めます。検証/NPZ組立は測定後で、RSSではありません。
limits.en: Fixed-step discrete adjoints, not CVODES or an optimal checkpoint schedule. The40n limit counts unique evolving state/adjoint/RHS/solve-scratch elements. Static factors/model arrays are separately listed and included in total bytes. Validation/NPZ assembly follows the ownership windows; this is not RSS.

limits.ja: 連続foldは離散foldではありません。rtol1e-4/1e-8は達成必須、requested1e-12は観測のみで未達を収束と表示しません。返却候補の独立勾配精度は別判定。最小固有値/丸めscaleは浮動小数点の診断で保証区間ではありません。BratuのJは対称であり、非対称転置は別の演算子対照です。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limits.en: The continuum fold is not the discrete fold. rtol1e-4/1e-8 targets are required; requested1e-12 is observational and unmet is never called converged. Independent accuracy of the returned gradient is a separate gate. Eigenvalue/roundoff scales are floating diagnostics, not certified intervals. Bratu J is symmetric; the nonsymmetric transpose is a separate operator control. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

limits.ja: 同じ離散状態の微分検証で、独立した物理PDE解の証明や一般ADではありません。保存arrayと固定Krylov workspaceの記録はRSS測定ではありません。m=2のθ端点は[a-b-2,a+b-2]で、物理係数端点[a-b,a+b]と区別します。 inputsの/solver/gmres/retention_adaptationはR1/R2の履歴記述で、現状態解法は新契約の明示混合精度が上書きします。射影解の未達は別保存します。
limits.en: Derivative verification at the same discrete state, not independent physical-PDE truth or general AD. Persistent arrays and fixed Krylov workspace inventories are not RSS measurements. For m=2, theta endpoints are[a-b-2,a+b-2], distinct from physical coefficient endpoints[a-b,a+b]. The retained /solver/gmres/retention_adaptation text is historicalR1/R2;the newcontract explicitly overrides it for mixed-precisionSTATEsolves. ProjectedUNMET is separatelysaved.

caption.ja: 公開コード版を固定条件で実行して作成した計算結果。条件・値・検査結果を添付。
caption.en: Calculated from the public code edition with fixed inputs; inputs, values and checks are linked.

method_note.ja: 共通実行例では減衰Newton法で前進の境界値問題を解きます。関連する自動微分・感度・随伴・係数推定の検証は各手法の別配布版へ進めます。感度・逆問題（1個または2個の係数）の入力と判定は別であり、共通の前進実行例に合算しません。
method_note.en: The common example solves the forward boundary-value problem with damped Newton. Related method pages lead to separate editions for automatic differentiation, sensitivities, adjoints and coefficient fitting. Sensitivity and inverse problems with one or two coefficients have separate inputs and acceptance checks; they are not added to the common forward execution entry.

name.ja: 時間離散拡散の随伴とcheckpoint
name.en: Discrete diffusion adjoint and checkpoint replay

scope.ja: 後退Eulerの離散写像を実際に逆伝播し、接線・独立高精度mode解・block replayと比較します。
scope.en: Reverse the actual backward-Euler map and compare tangent derivatives, independent high-precision modes and block replay.

method_note.ja: ThomasでB u次=u現在+dt θbを解き、Bの転置を逆順に解きます。16stepごとにcheckpointを保存し、1blockを同じ順で再計算します。full配列を保存・解放した後で別の所有期間を測ります。
method_note.en: Thomas solves B u_next=u_current+dt theta b; reverse solves use B transpose. Save checkpoints every16steps and replay one block in the original order. Serialize and release the full trajectory before the separate checkpoint ownership window.

name.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

caption.ja: 離散fold近傍のBratu感度。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

name.en: Bratu sensitivity near the discrete fold

scope.ja: 離散Bratuのfoldへ近づく6固定点で、状態誤差と線形許容差の影響を分け、独立shooting勾配と照合します。
scope.en: At six fixed points approaching the discrete Bratu fold, separate state error from linear-solve tolerance and compare against independent shooting gradients.

method_note.ja: 解析Jv、Poisson-Thomas右前処理、固定GMRES本体で接線と随伴を解きます。全rtol・最終候補・true residual・終了状態・丸めscaleを保存します。shootingと別の高精度Thomas-Newtonで離散参照を資格します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Analytic Jv, Poisson-Thomas right preconditioning and the preserved GMRES body solve tangents/adjoints. Save every rtol, returned candidate, true residual, termination and roundoff scale. Qualify the discrete oracle through shooting and separate high-precision Thomas-Newton. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.

name.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

caption.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP。実際の保存数値データの縮小図で、1次元問題です。
caption.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients. Preview from actual saved numerical data for a one-dimensional problem.

name.ja: 分布係数Bratuの行列非形成VJP
name.en: Matrix-free VJP for distributed Bratu coefficients

scope.ja: 2重みだけの局所hat作用で8/16/32個の空間係数を表し、目的関数ごとの随伴VJPを全感度参照と比較します。
scope.en: Represent8/16/32 spatial controls with two local hat weights per node; compare objective-wise adjoint VJPs with a separate full-sensitivity reference.

method_note.ja: Bvは局所gather、B転置はscatter-add。一次実装はn×m行列を作らずJvで解き、同一状態の1/3目的関数で実際に1個のPoisson因子を共有します。別の参照期間のみdense hatとm本の接線RHSを許可します。 R2は同じfloat64の隣接差を先に取る一般Jvで、元の非線形残差・GMRES・許容差は変更しません。 R3は状態Newton補正だけをhi+loで保持し、直接9積残差と3積状態更新を使います。物理状態はfloat64、感度/随伴GMRESは旧方式です。
method_note.en: Bv uses local gather and B transpose scatter-add. Primary solves use Jv without an n-by-m matrix. One shared Poisson factor serves the one/three-objective runs on the same state. Dense hats and m tangent RHS are allowed only in the separate reference window. R2 uses a general near-neighbor-difference association in binary64 Jv; the original nonlinear residual,GMRES and tolerances are unchanged. R3 expands only stateNewtoncorrections ashi+lo,direct9productresidual and3productstateupdate. Physicalstates stayfloat64;derivative/adjointGMRES staysordinary.
